lines.en: Heavy paws press the floorboards.
My top hat sits crooked.

lines.zh: 我一步一步挪，像在巡场。
lines.en: I shuffle, step by step, like a show check.
The microphone hangs in my hand.
I walk the edge of the stage.

lines.zh: 皮套上的缝开着，露出弹簧。
lines.en: The suit's seam is open, showing the spring.
Slow steps, never stopping.
I pass the rows of seats.
The light can't keep up with me.
I drag my toes forward.
Dust falls off me as I move.
At the door I turn back.
My paw lands with a muffled thud.
I step on an old poster.
Standing still, the hat doesn't move.

lines.zh: 麦克风上的漆掉了一半。
lines.en: Half the paint's gone from the microphone.
Head tilted, as if smiling.
Listening for footsteps.
The springs in me tick softly.
Are the lobby lights still on?

lines.zh: 麦克风的电池早就没电了。
lines.en: The microphone's battery died long ago.
This place used to be busy.
Hand raised to swing, then never mind.
It's stuffy inside this suit.
My stitched smile doesn't change.
Is someone singing on the stage?
I've waited a long time for you.
Would you like a show?

lines.zh: 你的手电让我眼睛发白。
lines.en: Your torch whites out my eyes.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，那样不礼貌。
lines.en: Don't look away. That's rude.

lines.zh: 我们的门票早就卖光了。
lines.en: Our tickets sold out long ago.
Do you remember this stage?
Should I applaud you?
You're front row, dead center.
The one under the mask is me.
A split opened in my suit.
The springs clang out of order.
Half a step back. Steady.
Something inside has shifted.
I shouldn't still feel pain.
Dust leaks out of the seams.
This body is what the fire left.
The microphone slipped from my hand.
I can still go on with the show.
Don't think that's the end of it.

lines.zh: 碰你一下就尖叫，然后没了。
lines.en: I scream at your touch, then vanish.
There's only springs in this body.

lines.zh: 你把披萨举给我？不必了。
lines.en: Offering me pizza? No need.
I remember there were meals here.
Go ahead and eat. I'll stand.
A machine's jaw doesn't close right.
Put it on the table. Don't spill.
All of this has gone cold.
You bumped my hat.
Don't press close, the springs rattle.
My body is hard.
One step back and neither of us crowds.
Your hand touched my paw.
I'm much heavier than I look.
Passing on my side? Go ahead.

lines.zh: 礼帽歪了，我用爪子扶正。
lines.en: My hat slipped; I straighten it with a claw.

lines.zh: 表演结束后没有这种事。
lines.en: There's no such thing after the show.
I don't know how to answer that.

lines.zh: 我的身体是被拼起来的。
lines.en: My body was assembled.
There's no other one here.
When the lights go out, I leave.

lines.zh: 别问一个机器这种问题。
lines.en: Don't ask a machine that.

lines.zh: 我的歌是唱给观众听的。
lines.en: My song is for the audience.
I only repeat motions.
That isn't something I should have.
I bend, and a spring pings.
Clamping it in my claws.
Dust on this hat.
A bit of cord. Might be useful.
My hands aren't nimble.
I'll stow it inside my chest.
Heavy, but I can hold it.
I put it back where it goes.
I just want to hold it.
A guest who won't leave.
I heard you shut the door.
The night isn't over.
You're standing where I should be.
The show should begin.
The light down the hall went out.
You'll hear me coming.
This performance needs no audience.
I've raised my paw.
This body is quicker than you.

lines.zh: 那扇侧门一直是锁着的。
lines.en: That side door stays locked.
That side door is locked.
Your breathing's behind the counter.

lines.zh: 每盏灯灭一次，我就近一步。
lines.en: Each light that dies, I gain a step.
You're behind the curtain.

lines.zh: 弹簧声是我最响的部分。
lines.en: The springs are the loudest part of me.

lines.zh: 弹簧圈随着我呼吸一响一响。
lines.en: The spring coils creak with every breath I take.
You've started back the way you came.
I don't need speed. You can't run far.

lines.zh: 我一碰你，就尖叫着消失。
lines.en: Touch you, scream, vanish.
My paw swung across.
I bear down with my whole arm.
That one dragged long.
You're at the wall.
I pin you against the seat back.

lines.zh: 你也听见那声尖叫了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear that scream too?
My hand's caught. Wait.
Not heavy, but very slow.

lines.zh: 这一记是给旧日的观众。
lines.en: That one's for the old audience.
I appear at the stage's side.
My hat enters the light first.
Every spring in the suit woke at once.
I lift the microphone.
Dust drifts around me.
This place is just as it was.
Someone put power into me.
I stand, taller than yesterday.
The seats are empty, row by row.

lines.zh: 布套被点着了，我不敢动。
lines.en: The cloth suit caught fire. I dare not move.
I fell off the stage and my leg bent wrong.
Water filled the suit. The circuits spark.
The blast opened half my shell.

lines.zh: 一枚飞来的东西打穿了我的胸口。
lines.en: Something punched through my chest.

lines.zh: 咒力让我的齿轮倒着转。
lines.en: The spell turned my gears backward.

lines.zh: 电池快空了，我抬不起手。
lines.en: The cell's nearly dead. I can't lift a hand.

lines.zh: 雷击让我的眼睛全亮了。
lines.en: The strike lit both my eyes.

lines.zh: 我往下沉，帽子先不见了。
lines.en: I'm sinking, and the hat goes first.
